sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN d.d_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS target_avg_total_amount, MAX(CASE WHEN d.d_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, MAX(CASE WHEN d.d_date = DATE '2025-01-20' THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS target_avg_trip_distance, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_date IN ('2025-01-06','2025-01-13','2025-01-27') THEN y.avg_total_amount END) AS baseline_avg_total_amount, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_date IN ('2025-01-06','2025-01-13','2025-01-27') THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN d.d_date IN ('2025-01-06','2025-01-13','2025-01-27') THEN y.avg_trip_distance END) AS baseline_avg_trip_distance FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 1 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31' GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
